Lemma
[Variation of Perelman's modified scalar curvature] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0053 ↗ def:chow-iii-ch17-linear-trace-harnack 1. ch17:17.29\group Variation Formulas

If $\partial _sg=v$ and $\partial _sf=\operatorname {tr}_gv$, so that $e^{-f}d\mu $ is fixed, then \[ \partial _s(R+2\Delta f-| abla f|^2) =L(v, abla f)-2\langle v,\Ric + abla ^2f angle . \]
Proof

\sketch Use the standard variations of scalar curvature, the Laplacian, and squared gradient norm. The double-divergence and Ricci contractions assemble into $L(v, abla f)$; the remaining Hessian and Ricci terms are exactly the last inner product.

□
